title: KP14 vyg25 with a CRASH in the priced state: a jump of y to -y_max at rate 1% a month, priced at e^2
question: Group 1 (different distributions): does a priced crash in the state widen vyg25's gap, as bvyj25 asks of BGN and gvyp10j of GS?
notes: Campaign 2026-10-12, group 1 cell for KP (docs/CAMPAIGN_REPORT_2026-10-11). IDENTICAL to var-kp_vy-vyg25-v4 except the model directory variants/kp_vj, a copy of kp_vy with a Poisson jump of y to -y_max in the physical generator (pj 0.01 a month, jump_rate 0.12 a year) and in the risk-neutral one (jump_rate_Q = jump_rate e^{gj} = 0.887 a year), in the A(y) solves, in the FD generator for G, in the simulated path and in the y' quadrature of the moments (an eighth node at -y_max with weight pj). The OU closed form for A(y) does not apply with the jump, so the gate checks the A solve's own linear system instead (residual 4.5e-12 at these parameters). Matches bvyj25 (pj 0.01, gj 2.0) and gvyp10j.
